algorithm.title: Sensitivity calculation from 2x2 clinical trial table

nodes.text: Prospective prognostic cohort study evaluating oxygenation index (> 20) predicting ARDS mortality
Identify reference standard outcome: total deaths from ARDS equals 75 patients (15 false negatives + 60 true positives)
Identify true positive tests: 60 patients with oxygenation index > 20 who died
Calculate sensitivity: true positives divided by total diseased individuals (60/75 = 80%)
**Specificity calculation:** true negatives divided by total survivors (25/45 = 56%)
**Positive predictive value:** true positives divided by all positive test results (60/80 = 75%)
High sensitivity is clinically optimal when screening tests must minimize missed fatal events
